parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-23 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 994.7 | 15.91 | 15.91
2 | 1719.5 | 4.88 | 20.79
3 | 7929.4 | 21.88 | 42.67
4 | 8125.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-23
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: None (no viable aquifer identified)
Recommendation: Drilling is not recommended at this location due to very high resistivities indicating dry overburden overlying tight, impermeable basement rock. Exploration should be redirected to an alternate station exhibiting lower resistivity signatures characteristic of a saturated weathered or fractured zone.
